zh.title: 國防部偵獲3架次中國軍機越過臺灣海峽中線 另偵獲9艘軍艦
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲3架次中國軍機越過臺灣海峽中線，另偵獲9艘軍艦
body: 國防部公佈的統計顯示，3架次中國軍機越過臺灣海峽中線，並在臺灣西南及東部周邊空域活動；同一統計期間另偵獲9艘中國軍艦。
這份統計涵蓋前一日上午6時至24日上午6時。國防部表示，國軍運用執行任務的軍機、軍艦及岸置飛彈系統，嚴密監控並應處相關動態。
本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次共機艦動態紀錄為11月23日，當時記錄共機5架次及共艦12艘。本站近7日的2筆紀錄，平均共機為每日11.0架次、共艦為11.5艘。

en.title: Taiwan defense ministry reports 3 Chinese military aircraft sorties across Taiwan Strait median line
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry reports three Chinese aircraft sorties across the Taiwan Strait median line; nine warships were detected.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said three Chinese military aircraft sorties crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and operated in airspace southwest and east of Taiwan. Nine Chinese military vessels were also detected during the same period.

The count covered the period from 6 a.m. the previous day to 6 a.m. on the 24th. The ministry said Taiwan's armed forces used mission aircraft, vessels and shore-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the activity.

SKYTICAL's own statistical records list five Chinese military aircraft sorties and 12 Chinese military vessels in the previous entry, dated November 23. Two entries in the past seven days averaged 11.0 aircraft sorties a day and 11.5 vessels.
